concerns.text: Task T013 mandates sampling exactly N=1,000 complexes via power analysis. This silently weakens Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires fetching the 'same canonical source on every run' without arbitrary sampling that alters dataset composition. The spec/plan defines the scope as the 'PDBbind v2020 refined set' (a fixed collection); sampling creates a non-reproducible state.

Task T037 requires a 'Permutation test with multiple iterations of atom coordinate permutations'. This violates FR-008 and SC-003 which require a null distribution generated by permuting 'motif labels' or using a mixed-effects model. Shuffling atom coordinates destroys the molecular graph topology required for the GNN and Integrated Gradients (FR-003), rendering the statistical validation scientifically invalid and unexecutable as described.

Task T044b defines MM-GBSA as a 'Primary Alternative' to be executed for *all* novel scaffolds. This weakens FR-005 and US-3 which specify MM-GBSA only as a fallback 'or by validating... for novel scaffolds' when pharmacophore matching fails. Elevating this to a primary path for all novel scaffolds introduces significant computational scope creep not authorized by the spec.

Task T052 requires modifying the GNN architecture to 'explicitly incorporate the water_flag... as distinct node/edge types'. This contradicts FR-002 which strictly defines the model as a '3-layer message-passing GNN with 128 hidden units' (fixed architecture). The spec's edge case handling (FR-009) only requires *flagging* water interactions, not architectural modification to model them as distinct types.

Task T013 mandates 'Power Analysis' to justify N=1,000 and sampling the dataset. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and the Plan's scope of the 'PDBbind v2020 refined set' (a fixed collection). Sampling a subset based on a power analysis creates a non-reproducible dataset state that violates the 'single source of truth' requirement for data artifacts.
